description: Free, read-only, no network. Browse all 47 tools in 10 families (web, seo, data, documents, images, media, utils, payments, recipes, meta). No args: families with id, label, one-liner, tool count. family='<id>': each tool with name, price, description, notes, inputSchema. tool='<name>': that entry alone; wins over family. Unknown ids error naming the valid families. Run what you find via use_tool.

family.description: Family id, e.g. 'web', 'data'. Lists its tools with schemas.

tool.description: Exact tool name, e.g. 'fetch_rendered'. Takes precedence over family.

name: tool_catalog
title: Browse tool catalog
